join_page.title: Sell on SariKo
join_page.subtitle: Seller application
join_page.tip_title: Tip: this form is easier on a computer
join_page.tip_body: Copy the link and open it on a computer. Your draft is saved only on this device, so you would start again there. You can also finish here.
join_page.welcome_point_1: Sell your home cooking to the Filipino community in Ho Chi Minh City.
join_page.welcome_point_2: SariKo handles ordering, online payment (VNPAY) and Lalamove delivery.
join_page.welcome_point_3: You pay a service fee only on completed orders. Plans with a monthly fee have a lower rate.
join_page.welcome_point_4: Payouts go to your own Vietnamese bank account, with a statement for each period.
join_page.welcome_point_5: SariKo withholds and pays the tax on your sales for you, as Vietnamese law requires.
join_page.welcome_guide_link: Read the Seller Briefing (fees, payouts, tax)
join_page.welcome_prepare_id: Passport (photo page) or CCCD (front and back)
join_page.welcome_prepare_bank: A Vietnamese bank account in your own name
join_page.welcome_time: Takes about 15 to 20 minutes. Your text is saved on this device as you go; photos and files are not, so add them in one sitting.
join_page.about_hint: Write your name exactly as on your passport or CCCD.
join_page.label_residential_address: Home address in Ho Chi Minh City
join_page.hint_residential_address: Where you live. It can be different from your kitchen.
join_page.label_tax_resident: Do you stay in Vietnam 183 days or more a year?
join_page.hint_tax_resident: This sets the tax rate SariKo withholds.
join_page.plan_hint: Pick a plan. It sets how many dishes and categories you can list. You can change plans later, from the next month.
join_page.plan_vat_note: Fees exclude VAT at the current rate. The service fee is charged on the food amount of completed orders, not on delivery fees.
join_page.plan_founding: SariKo personally invited me as a Founding Seller
join_page.plan_founding_hint: Founding Sellers (first {slots}): no monthly fee for the first {months} months, then {fee} a month and {rate}%. SariKo confirms this when reviewing your application.
join_page.hint_store_description: What you cook, in one or two sentences.
join_page.hint_pickup_address: Where the driver picks up orders (your kitchen).
join_page.label_maps_link: Google Maps link of your kitchen
join_page.hint_maps_link: Optional. Open Google Maps, press and hold on your kitchen, tap Share, then Copy link.
join_page.menu_hint: Add every dish you want to sell. Price options (small, large...) can be added in the app after approval.
join_page.menu_photo_hint: Each dish needs one clear photo. Take it with your phone camera or pick one from your gallery.
join_page.documents_hint: JPG, PNG or PDF, up to {mb} MB each. SariKo keeps these private and uses them only to verify you, pay you and file tax.
join_page.doc_id_document_hint: The page with your photo and passport number.
join_page.doc_residence_card_hint: Your temporary residence card, if you have one.
join_page.doc_food_safety_hint: Required before you can start selling. Upload it now if you have it.
join_page.doc_business_registration_hint: Only if you are a registered household business or company.
join_page.payout_hint: Payouts are bank transfers in VND to a Vietnamese bank account in your own name.
join_page.hint_bank_account_holder: Exactly as your bank shows it. The account must be in your own name.
join_page.review_hint: Check everything before you sign. Tap Edit to change a section.
join_page.agreement_open: Open the agreement in a new tab
join_page.agree_accurate: The information and documents I gave are true and are my own.
join_page.agree_fees: I understand the fees, how payouts work, and that SariKo withholds VAT and personal income tax on my sales as Vietnamese law requires.
join_page.agree_data: I agree that SariKo processes my personal data to review this application and run my seller account.
join_page.agree_agreement: I have read and agree to the SariKo Seller Agreement (version {version}).
